name: criterion-2
text: Criterion 2 (O-1A 2, EB-1A ii): membership in associations requiring outstanding achievement, judged by recognized experts.

Counts (C2-selective-membership): a fellowship or association with selective criteria; YC or accelerator acceptance (decisions-5-5); IADAS; merit-based open-source organization membership; ownership of a repo with a merit-based contributor community.
Rejected (T-open-membership): memberships anyone can buy or join without review; open chat communities.
Signals: acceptance emails with stated criteria; program pages.
